CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to identified content present.

COD.rationale: Content (red positions), an organization/presentation statement, and an explicit origin/status entry are present and bound to the same p0/current/n1 referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition linked to the identified content's organization/access.

C.rationale: The report explicitly lists identified contents (color-labeled coordinate sets) with attribute values.

D.rationale: Origin/metadata entries separately attribute status/origin to the identified content.

O.rationale: The text states presentation mapping ('Rows increase down; columns right.') and shows organized coordinate sets for contents.
